Who we are

Chatversio AI (“Chatversio”, “we”, “us”) designs and builds AI agents for chat, sales follow-up and voice, along with document processing, social messaging channels, lead generation and integrations. This policy explains what personal information we collect through this website and how we use it. If you are a customer’s end user talking to an agent we built for that customer, the customer’s own privacy policy also applies.

Information we collect

We collect only what you choose to send us:

  • Enquiry form: your name, work email, and optionally your company, phone number, website, area of interest and the message you write.
  • Discovery call requests: your name, email, preferred date and time, your time zone and your preferred meeting platform (Google Meet or Zoom).
  • Technical data: like most websites, our servers may process your IP address, browser type and the pages requested so that the site can be delivered securely and kept reliable.

This site does not use advertising cookies. It stores one small preference in your browser (chatversio-motion) to remember whether you paused animations.

How we use your information

  • To reply to your enquiry and discuss whether an agent suits your business.
  • To confirm, reschedule or follow up on a discovery call. A request is treated as pending until our team confirms it.
  • To keep the website secure and prevent spam and abuse.
  • To improve our website and the way we explain our services.

We do not sell your personal information.

Agents, conversations and customer data

When we build and run agents for a business, the conversations, contact details and documents an agent handles are processed on that business’s behalf and under its instructions. During discovery we agree which information an agent may use, where it is stored and when it hands over to a person. Please contact the business you are speaking with about their use of your data.

Sharing and service providers

We share information only with people and providers who help us operate: for example hosting, email and calendar tools, a CRM, and meeting platforms such as Google Meet or Zoom. They may only use it to provide their service to us. We may also disclose information if the law requires it or to protect our rights and users.

Retention

We keep enquiries and meeting requests for as long as needed to respond and to maintain a reasonable record of our discussions, then delete or anonymise them. You can ask us to delete your information sooner.

Security

Enquiries are stored in a private location that is not publicly accessible, and access is limited to people who need it. No online service is completely secure, so please avoid sending passwords, payment card numbers or other highly sensitive information through the website forms.

Your choices and rights

Depending on where you live, you may have the right to access, correct, delete or export your personal information, to object to or restrict certain processing, and to withdraw consent. To make a request, use our contact form and mention “privacy request”. We will respond within a reasonable time and may need to verify your identity first.

Children

Our website and services are intended for businesses and are not directed at children. We do not knowingly collect information from children.

Changes to this policy

We may update this policy as the website or our services change. The date at the top shows when it was last revised.

Contact us

Questions about this policy? Reach us through the contact page.
